observed_result.held_out: blue diagonal is judged blue cross by both groups in every seed: the colour word carries over to the unseen pairing, the unseen shape pairing does not.
observed_result.capacity_split: encoder 96, core 5,280 (weights, bias, log tau), readout 12,288, decoder 0 parameters; the core group trains encoder, core and readout, the frozen-core group only encoder and readout (core_trains false).
observed_result.samples: samples/ holds the seed-1 trained core's own output for all nine prompts as 8x8 RGB PNG files (WriteSamples retrains the core exactly as RunMedia does), not the rendered targets.
observed_result.reading: The core path generates the images and reaches all eight seen conditions in every seed; the prompt reaches the pixels only through the core, and zeroing every core weight changes the output. The frozen-core control does exactly as well, so on this fixture the capability comes from the trainable encoder and readout and training the recurrent weights adds nothing measurable. The held-out condition is not generated correctly.
observed_result.reproducibility: The rerun at the same commit produced byte-identical media.json, summary.txt and PNG samples.

assumption_statement: Pixel or sample MSE says nothing about perceptual quality. This proves generation on a finite fixture of nine conditions, not open-ended image or audio generation. The decoder is a fixed clamp with no parameters; the prompt reaches the output only through the core. The frozen-core control trains only the encoder and readout, showing what the periphery alone can do with the same budget. (The four assumptions RunMedia writes into media.json.)
limitations: Nine 8x8x3 fixture images; no claim about natural images, resolution or perceptual quality.
The held-out condition is generated wrongly in every seed (blue cross instead of blue diagonal); no compositional generalisation is shown.
The frozen-core control matches the trained core, so the recurrent core's learning is not shown to matter on this fixture.
Real authorised image data is TSK-11 and remains blocked_data.
